title: Founding myths of star people teaching agriculture
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Founding myths of star people teaching agriculture, about c. 10,000 years ago at worldwide, and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: And just about every founding myth talks about people from the stars, you know, teaching us agriculture.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, speaking with a Harvard astronomer, Avi Loeb, says that nearly every culture's founding myth talks about people from the stars teaching humans how to farm. He offers it as a hint that visitors from elsewhere may have shaped early human civilisation.
